description: SMTP-to-HTTP bridge. Receives email through the UnitySVC SMTP gateway and forwards the faithful, lossless email envelope (`from`, `to`, `subject`, `text_body`, `html_body`, headers, attachments, spf/dkim) as an HTTP POST to your own HTTP endpoint — for internal webhooks, Zapier-style automations, or any HTTP receiver. This is a multi-channel service: the free `byok` channel forwards every message to one endpoint you store once as customer secrets (`HTTP_RELAY_BASE_URL`, optional `HTTP_RELAY_API_KEY`), while the metered `plus` channel lets you run many email-to-webhook routes under a single account — each enrollment binds its own destination `base_url` and is reached at a unique `/e/<code>` address. See “How to use this service” for both channels.
name: smtp-to-http

payout_price.description: No platform commission — customer uses own HTTP receiver
